lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਤਿਆਗੇ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਲਬਧਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tan kai charan laage kaam krodh lobh tiaage gur gopaal bhae kripaal labadh apanee paaee ||1||
lines.translation: Grasping hold of the Feet of the Saints, I have abandoned sexual desire, anger and greed. The Guru, the Lord of the World, has been kind to me, and I have realized my destiny. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਅੰਧ ਟੂਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੰਧ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਹ ਕੋਊ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: binase bhram moh a(n)dh toote maaiaa ke ba(n)dh pooran sarabatr thaakur nah kooo bairaaee ||
lines.translation: My doubts and attachments have been dispelled, and the blinding bonds of Maya have been broken. My Lord and Master is pervading and permeating everywhere; no one is an enemy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: suaamee suprasa(n)n bhae janam maran dokh gae sa(n)tan kai charan laag naanak gun gaaee ||2||3||132||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master is totally satisfied with me; He has rid me of the pains of death and birth. Grasping hold of the Feet of the Saints, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||3||132||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har hare har mukhahu bol har hare man dhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; enshrine the Lord, Har, Har, within your mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: sravan sunan bhagat karan anik paatik punahacharan ||
lines.translation: Hear Him with your ears, and practice devotional worship - these are good deeds, which make up for past evils.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਨ ਪਰਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਆਨ ਬਾਨਿ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saran paran saadhoo aan baan bisaare ||1||
lines.translation: So seek the Sanctuary of the Holy, and forget all your other habits. ||1||.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨੀਤ ਨੀਤਿ ਪਾਵਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: har charan preet neet neet paavanaa mahi mahaa puneet ||
lines.translation: Love the Lord's Feet, continually and continuously - the most sacred and sanctified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਭੈ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਨ ਕਲਿਮਲ ਦੋਖ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevak bhai door karan kalimal dokh jaare ||
lines.translation: Fear is taken away from the servant of the Lord, and the dirty sins and mistakes of the past are burnt away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਮੁਕਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਮੁਕਤ ਰਹਤ ਜਨਮ ਰਹਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat mukat sunat mukat rahat janam rahate ||
lines.translation: Those who speak are liberated, and those who listen are liberated; those who keep the Rehit, the Code of Conduct, are not reincarnated again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਸਾਰ ਭੂਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: raam raam saar bhoot naanak tat beechaare ||2||4||133||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is the most sublime essence; Nanak contemplates the nature of reality. ||2||4||133||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਾਗੁ ਸੰਤ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam bhagat maag sa(n)t tiaag sagal kaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I beg for devotion to the Naam, the Name of the Lord; I have forsaken all other activities. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਗੁਨ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: preet laai har dhiaai gun goubi(n)d sadaa gaai ||
lines.translation: Meditate lovingly on the Lord, and sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਬਾਂਛੁ ਦੈਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har jan kee ren baa(n)chh dainahaar suaamee ||1||
lines.translation: I long for the dust of the feet of the Lord's humble servant, O Great Giver, my Lord and Master. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਕੁਸਲ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ਆਨਦਾ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab kusal sukh bisraam aanadaa aana(n)d naam jam kee kachh naahi traas simar a(n)tarajaamee ||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the ultimate ecstasy, bliss, happiness, peace and tranquility. The fear is death is dispelled by meditating in remembrance on the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਸਰਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਗਲ ਤਾਪ ਹਰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek saran gobi(n)d charan sa(n)saar sagal taap haran ||
lines.translation: Only the Sanctuary of the Feet of the Lord of the Universe can destroy all the suffering of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਵ ਰੂਪ ਸਾਧਸੰਗ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੩੪॥
lines.transliteration: naav roop saadhasa(n)g naanak paaragaraamee ||2||5||134||
lines.translation: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is the boat, O Nanak, to carry us across to the other side. ||2||5||134||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਲਾਲ ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun laal gaavau gur dekhe ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon my Guru, I sing the Praises of my Beloved Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚਾ ਤੇ ਏਕੁ ਛੂਟਾ ਜਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪਗ ਰਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)chaa te ek chhootaa jau saadhasa(n)g pag rau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I escape from the five thieves, and I find the One, when I join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਉ ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮੋਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: drisatau kachh sa(n)g na jaai maan tiaag mohaa ||
lines.translation: Nothing of the visible world shall go along with you; abandon your pride and attachment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸੋਹਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ekai har preet laai mil saadhasa(n)g sohaa ||1||
lines.translation: Love the One Lord, and join the Saadh Sangat, and you shall be embellished and exalted. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਓ ਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਗਲ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: paaio hai gun nidhaan sagal aas pooree ||
lines.translation: I have found the Lord, the Treasure of Excellence; all my hopes have been fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਿਖਮ ਗਾਰ੍ਹ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak man ana(n)d bhae gur bikham gaarh toree ||2||6||135||
lines.translation: Nanak's mind is in ecstasy; the Guru has shattered the impregnable fortress. ||2||6||135||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬਿਰਾਗੈਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: man biraagaigee ||
lines.translation: My mind is neutral and detached;

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤੀ ਦਰਸਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: khojatee darasaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I seek only the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਤਨ ਸੇਵਿ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)tan sev kai priu heearai dhiaaio ||
lines.translation: Serving the Holy Saints, I meditate on my Beloved within my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਰੂਪੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵਉਗੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aana(n)d roopee pekh kai hau mahal paavaugee ||1||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Embodiment of Ecstasy, I rise to the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੀ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਉਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam karee sabh tiaag kai hau saran paraugee ||
lines.translation: I work for Him; I have forsaken everything else. I seek only His Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਉ ਗੁਰ ਮਨਾਵਉਗੀ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak suaamee gar mile hau gur manaavaugee ||2||7||136||
lines.translation: O Nanak, my Lord and Master hugs me close in His Embrace; the Guru is pleased and satisfied with me. ||2||7||136||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੀ ਹੋਇ ਪਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisee hoi paree ||
lines.translation: This is my condition.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਨਤੇ ਦਇਆਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaanate daiaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Only my Merciful Lord knows it. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਰ ਪਿਤਰ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕੈ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਾਹਿ ਬੇਚਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: maatar pitar tiaag kai man sa(n)tan paahi bechaaio ||
lines.translation: I have abandoned my mother and father, and sold my mind to the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਤਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੁਲ ਖੋਈਐ ਹਉ ਗਾਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaat janam kul khoeeai hau gaavau har haree ||1||
lines.translation: I have lost my social status, birth-right and ancestry; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਤੇ ਟੂਟੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: lok kuta(n)b te tooteeai prabh kirat kirat karee ||
lines.translation: I have broken away from other people and family; I work only for God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਿ ਏਕ ਹਰੀ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੩੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur mo kau upadesiaa naanak sev ek haree ||2||8||137||
lines.translation: The Guru has taught me, O Nanak, to serve only the One Lord. ||2||8||137||
